### Ingredients

| Ingredient | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| San Marzano tomatoes | two 28oz cans |
| Pork neck bones | 2 lbs |
| Italian sausage | 1 lb |
| Yellow onion, diced | 1 large |
| Garlic | 6 cloves |
| Basil | 1 handful |

### Instructions

1. Brown the pork bones and sausage in a heavy pot, then set aside.
2. Soften the onion and garlic in the rendered fat.
3. Crush in the tomatoes, return the meat, and simmer 4 hours.
4. Finish with torn basil.
